# SIP (`sip`)

- **Layer**: Application and control
- **Header**: variable length
- **Notes**: [MACsec / GTPv2-C / Diameter / SIP / RTP (P2)](../../protocols/mobile-voip.md)

## Reached from

| Lower layer | Selector | Value |
|---|---|---|
| [`tcp`](tcp.md) | `dst_port` / `src_port` | 5060 (0x13c4) |
| [`udp`](udp.md) | `dst_port` / `src_port` | 5060 (0x13c4) |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `start_line` | `bytes` — up to the terminator `0d 0a` (appended when building) | `"OPTIONS sip:bob@example.com SIP/2.0"` |   | Start line: a request line (method, Request-URI, SIP/2.0) or a status line (SIP/2.0, code, reason). The CRLF is added automatically. |
| `headers` | `list<bytes>` — up to the terminator `0d 0a` (appended when building) | 9 items |   | Header lines (Name: value), one per element; the CRLFs and the empty line after them are added automatically. Content-Length is Manual. |
| `body` | `bytes` — rest of the PDU | `""` |   | Message body (an SDP offer / answer, ...). |
